sqf: private _player = allPlayers select 0; private _dir = getDir _player; private _pos = _player getPos [3, _dir]; private _box = createVehicle ['B_supplyCrate_F', _pos, [], 0, 'NONE']; _box setDir (_dir + 180); ['AmmoboxInit', [_box, true]] call BIS_fnc_arsenal; [_box, allItems + allWeapons + allMagazines + allUniformItems] call ace_arsenal_fnc_addVirtualItems; _box addAction ['<t color="#00FF00">Open Virtual Arsenal</t>', {['Open', true] call BIS_fnc_arsenal;}]; _box addAction ['<t color="#00FFFF">Open ACE Arsenal</t>', {[player, _this select 0, true] call ace_arsenal_fnc_openBox;}]; ['FULL Virtual Arsenal placed - use scroll menu to open.'] remoteExec ['systemChat', 0];
